name: encoding-reflection-decoded-type-methods
description: A type only a decoder reaches keeps the decoding methods the decoder resolves by name and no other method, so a method nothing calls is reported, and an embedded field is live while the program reads a member it promotes. A field of a pointer, interface or map type that the program writes and that a decoder reaches is read by the decoder, which decodes into the value the field holds, while a field of another type that the program writes before the decode is reported as written and never read.
